discovery.auth: HTTP Basic with API-account credentials issued by mobile.de support

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). mobile.de publishes Seller-API, Search-API, Ad-Stream and Insights-API docs; API accounts are activated by customer support.

fields.name: username
fields.help: Username of a mobile.de API account (Search-API / Ad-Integration access is activated by mobile.de customer support); HTTP Basic.

fields.name: password
fields.help: Password of that API account (HTTP Basic).

adapter.terms: mobile.de Search-API ('Ad-Integration'); some API users only see the ads of an agreed set of dealers (applied automatically). Prices in EUR (gross), mileage in km.

search_listings.note: GET https://services.mobile.de/search-api/search (Accept: application/vnd.de.mobile.api+json). make is mobile.de's make key (e.g. AUDI, BMW → classification=refdata/classes/Car/makes/<make>); model is matched as modelDescription text; year_min/year_max filter the first registration (YYYY-01 … YYYY-12); location is the seller's ISO-3166 country code (e.g. DE, AT). mobile.de rejects searches carrying only numeric filters, so give make, model, condition or location. At most 2,000 ads are reachable per query (page.size ≤ 100). `query` is not used (no free-text parameter). price.consumerPriceGross (a decimal string, EUR) and firstRegistration (YYYYMM) stay in raw.

get_listing.note: GET https://services.mobile.de/search-api/ad/{ad-key} (the mobileAdId): the full ad, richer than a search row; price.consumerPriceGross (decimal string, EUR), firstRegistration, seller and images stay in raw. 404 for a wrong ad-key.

not_offered.decode_vin: The Search-API has no VIN lookup (vin is only a field of an ad).
not_offered.get_valuation: Valuations are not part of the Search-API (the separate Insights-API is not covered here).
not_offered.list_dealers: The Search-API filters by customerNumber/customerId but has no dealer directory endpoint.
not_offered.me: No account/identity endpoint in the Search-API.

evidence: host services.mobile.de: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (ZeroSSL GmbH)
probe: 2/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 2/2 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
